organization_invitations_open_email_uniq.name: organization_invitations_open_email_unique
organization_invitations_open_email_uniq.where: accepted_at is null and revoked_at is null

organizations_membership.name: organizations_membership
organizations_membership.using: id = app_current_org_id() or id in (select m.organization_id from organization_members m where m.user_id = app_current_user_id())

audit_logs_tenant_isolation.name: audit_logs_tenant_isolation
audit_logs_tenant_isolation.withCheck: organization_id is null or organization_id = app_current_org_id()

redirects_source_is_path.name: redirects_source_is_path
redirects_source_is_path.value: source_path like '/%' and source_path not like '/\_forge%'

jobs_active_dedupe_unique.name: jobs_active_dedupe_unique
jobs_active_dedupe_unique.where: dedupe_key is not null and status in ('queued', 'running')
